fixed_algorithm.generator_rule: identical straight-line generator from prior admitted codegen milestone

representative_layouts.W5_SINGLE: all b logical bits in state/key word5 bits0..b-1
representative_layouts.W4_W6_SPLIT: for even b, low b/2 bits in word4 and high b/2 bits in word6

exactness_gate: generated full syndrome and direct predicate must equal generic reference for every candidate in every frozen layout/b/target case

wall_protocol.timed_scope: target output + specialized target cache + all 2^b candidates + survivor verification

family_gate: both representative layouts must pass all gates at all four b values
accounting: report survivor counts, structural QR ratio, wall speedup, generated source bytes and generation/compile wall; fit log2 wall slopes as diagnostics
claim_limit: Scaling may broaden only the tested-layout constant-factor wall claim. Leading candidate enumeration remains 2^b and algorithmic alpha=1 by construction. No full-round claim.
